protocol.holdout_distribution: same-generator seeded mixed-input holdout; no distribution-shift claim
protocol.objective: combined cold executor lifecycle plus warm pass elapsed

selection.exhaustive: arithmetic mean of four paired training repeats
selection.exhaustive_median: median of four paired repeats, statistic-matched control for budgeted search
selection.budgeted: PRIMARY: successive halving, median score, minimum two paired repeats, maximum four, 72 callback limit
selection.budgeted_lowcost: SECONDARY: successive halving, median score, minimum one paired repeat, maximum four, 48 callback limit

protocol.selection_cost_scope: measured-matrix replay; virtual callback seconds summed from requested real training rows; fixture/reference costs separate; replay wall is not live search cost

baselines.standard_library_fixed: ThreadPoolExecutor at declared CPU-affinity worker cap, batch one
baselines.manual_tuning_proxy: exhaustive mean-ranked training-only standard-library grid, same candidates/repeats/objective/gates; no claimed human expert
baselines.direct_python: two direct sequential passes of the same workload algorithm, no executor

protocol.oracle: all declared candidate configurations on every independent heldout seed; aggregate oracle requires all gates on all seeds
protocol.limits: one actual host, generated local mixed-input workloads, fixed explicit process safety; no upstream service compatibility, global optimum, cross-hardware generalization or deployment certification

calibration_memory_reserve.status: Experimental post-failure choice; no reservation, enforcement, safety guarantee, or validated universal factor.

fresh_context.fixture_scope: Regenerate the same declared seed/profile and independent reference in each fresh interpreter; require exact reference digest match.
fresh_context.retention_scope: Fresh selected context versus reused-parent selected rows; descriptive, order-confounded retention comparison, not causal isolation.
fresh_context.selection: Primary budgeted choice frozen before any heldout fixture is prepared; no heldout reselection.

experiment.required_adapter: candidate Bold42 generated typography revision; exact text truth unchanged
experiment.resource_attribution: 10 ms process-tree sampling; start/end and parent/descendant RSS at the observed tree peak use non-atomic sweeps and may miss spikes or double-count shared pages.
experiment.scope: Separate post-primary development experiment; the original 11-stratum evidence universe and every recorded failure remain unchanged. Acceptance definitions stay with the original reports and analysis.

protocol.fixture_failure_handling: Cache one preparation/reference failure per seed; retain explicit unexecuted grid slots, with no fabricated callback cost or tasks.

public_metadata_projection.scope: metadata-only public projection; all numeric measurements, configuration choices, source hashes and hardware characteristics unchanged
public_metadata_projection.redacted: absolute interpreter/checkout/temporary paths and report-only hardware fingerprint values
public_metadata_projection.saved_configuration_status: report copies containing redacted fingerprints are intentionally not loadable saved profiles; runtime APIs and raw evidence are unchanged
public_metadata_projection.original_selection_hash_status: original frozen selection hashes are retained as run provenance; metadata-redacted selection content has a separate projected hash
